title: Matching an inserted fixed assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $P\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and let $z$ assign signs to the coordinates in $P$. Choose a coordinate $i\\notin P$, a sign $v$, and an input $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$. Then $x$ agrees with the fixed assignment obtained by extending $z$ to set coordinate $i$ to $v$ if and only if $x$ agrees with $z$ on every coordinate in $P$ and $x_i=v$.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$
$x$ is an input in the $n$-dimensional sign cube
